_comment: Railway template for the StingStream account service.
A SECOND service, deliberately not the coordinator. They hold completely different data with
completely different blast radii: the coordinator holds nothing and can be redeployed at will,
this one holds every account and needs a volume. Keeping them apart is also what lets the
coordinator keep saying it has no accounts and no secrets.
A VOLUME IS REQUIRED at /data. Without one, a redeploy loses every account and signs everybody
out — the container filesystem does not survive one.
TLS is Railway's: the proxy terminates it and this serves plain HTTP on $PORT.

STINGSTREAM_ACCOUNTS_DATA.description: Where accounts.db and signing.key live. Must be a mounted volume.

STINGSTREAM_ACCOUNTS_ORIGIN.description: This service's public origin, with scheme. Passkeys will be bound to its hostname, so changing it later invalidates every passkey registered against it.
